transcript: Last night, I attended Wonderful Joe by Ronnie Burkett, a solo puppetry show being presented as part of the Under the Radar Festival. This was actually so cool — Ronnie manipulates over a dozen puppets of various sizes, and assumes different voices for each of them. The story itself is charming and humorous, kind of an episodic day in the life where we encounter different characters within a community. Above all else, I was just super impressed by the puppetry design and manipulation, and the level of detail in the craftsmanship and execution of the show. This would be great to check out if you're into puppetry or if you haven't seen much puppetry on stage before, I think this will surprise you.
